# Telix Highlights Pivotal Trials in Prostate, Brain and Renal Cancers and Next Generation Theranostics at EANM


**Melbourne (Australia) and Indianapolis, IN (United States) | October 14, 2026**


Telix today announces that 20 company-related abstracts will be presented at the 39th Annual Congress of the European Association of Nuclear Medicine (EANM) to be held in Vienna, Austria from October 17-21, 2026.


Dr. David N. Cade, Telix Group Chief Medical Officer, said, “Our expansive presence at EANM reflects the breadth and maturity of Telix’s pipeline, spanning pivotal therapeutic studies, precision diagnostics and next-generation technologies. The selection of 12 abstracts for top-rated oral presentations is a strong recognition of the quality and clinical relevance of this work. We look forward to continuing this discussion at our sponsored symposium on the future of theranostics in urologic oncology.”


Key presentations include the Phase 3 IPAX BrIGHT trial of TLX101-Tx in recurrent glioblastoma, the Phase 3 LUTEON trial of TLX250-Tx in ccRCC, and interim results from the PTherpan-Lu trial of TLX597-Tx in mAPMR prostate cancer\[1\] . Topline Phase 3 data for TLX591-Px (Illuccix) PET\[2\] imaging of prostate cancer in Chinese men will also be presented, together with real-world experience with TLX250-Px (Zircaix\[3\] ) in ccRCC, and research from our targeted alpha therapy and MedTech programs. As in previous years, Telix will support the EANM Sanjiv Sam Gambhir Young Investigator Award, in memory of an extraordinary man and inspiring educator.


Visit booth #527 to explore opportunities for collaboration with Illuccix® (kit for the preparation of gallium-68 gozetotide injection), Telix’s commercial PSMA-PET imaging\[4\] agent in Europe; our theranostic pipeline; and our medical technologies, including the SENSEI® miniature drop-in gamma probe, QDOSE® dosimetry software and artificial intelligence (AI).
